title: Night Market Poster and Reel
tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

faults.what: No separate finished still poster is supplied in the presented output; only frames from the video are shown.

judge.summary: The silent vertical reel has attractive warm illustrations, animated steam and lights, and clear event details, but the separate requested poster is missing.

must_haves.item: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
must_haves.why: An eight-second portrait reel is shown, but no separate still poster is supplied.

must_haves.item: Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
must_haves.why: All five strings are exact and clearly readable in the reel; a separate poster is not available to inspect.

must_haves.item: Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
must_haves.why: The reel shows warm illustrated food stalls and string lights in gold and navy, but no separate poster is shown for comparison.

must_haves.item: The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
must_haves.why: Steam shapes and glowing particles visibly change between sampled frames while all five text lines remain stable, unobstructed, and readable.

must_haves.item: The reel has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio report confirms the eight-second clip is silent.
